title: First Steps
summary: Get to know your guitar: hold it, tune it, read tab and chord diagrams, and play your first notes and melody.

title: Open Chords I
summary: Seven essential open chords (Em, Am, E, A, D, G and C), clean fretting and smooth changes over steady downstrokes.

title: Rhythm Foundations
summary: Down and up strums, eighth notes, the strum patterns behind countless songs, steady time and your first full songs.

title: Open Chords II & Riffs
summary: Dm, Dsus2 and Dsus4, Cadd9, the seventh chords E7, A7, D7 and G7, single-note riffs, hammer-ons and pull-offs.

title: Barre Chords & Power Chords
summary: Power chords on the E and A strings, palm muting, the F and Bm barre chords and movable shapes.

title: Lead Guitar I
summary: The minor pentatonic scale (boxes 1 and 2), alternate picking, slides, bends and vibrato, and the 12-bar blues.

title: Fingerstyle & Theory
summary: Travis picking and arpeggios, the major scale, keys, the I–IV–V and I–V–vi–IV progressions, and using a capo.

title: Intermediate Musician
summary: Pentatonic and major scale positions across the neck, triads, improvising, syncopated rhythms and complete songs.
